ambiguities_or_notes: The source's comic high diction is kept in phrases such as ‘spoke thus’ and ‘the life to come and this day’; no new rhyme scheme is imposed.
‘Сокрушенъ ея тоскою’ is translated closely as ‘Crushed by her sorrow’ rather than inferred as the mouse's own longing.
The duplicated prereform/regularized title tokens in the Markdown body are treated as witness-layer orthographic duplication; the substantive heading is translated once as ‘To the Trap.’
